description: This file defines device configurations and build parameters for different hardware platforms based on sunxi architecture within the OpenWrt project. It specifies device-specific settings, supported devices, and common configurations using Makefile syntax.

methods.name: Device/sun50i
methods.description: Defines common configuration for sun50i-based devices, including enabling LZMA fit images and setting kernel image name.

methods.description: Defines configuration for sun50i-a64 SoC, inheriting from sun50i.

methods.description: Defines configuration for sun50i-h5 SoC, inheriting from sun50i.
